scripts.text: I am waiting for my master.  Brave adventurer, follow your destiny!
scripts.translation: 我在等候主人。勇敢的冒险者，追随你的命运吧！

scripts.text: I am here to follow ^5533FF{0}^000000's command! Hey! Your not even a part of the guild!!
scripts.translation: 我在遵从^5533FF{0}^000000的命令！喂！你根本不是公会成员！！

scripts.text: Where are the guardians? Destroy these intruders!
scripts.translation: 守卫们在哪里？快消灭这些入侵者！

scripts.text: You're not ^5533FF{0}^000000! I am here to follow ^5533FF{1}^000000's command only
Welcome Master ^5533FF{0}^000000 ! I will assist you in any way I can!
scripts.translation: 欢迎，会长^5533FF{0}^000000！我会尽力协助你！

scripts.text: Kafra Staff Employment / Dismissal
scripts.translation: 雇用/解雇卡普拉员工

scripts.text: Enter Treasure Room
scripts.translation: 进入宝物库

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Master, you don't have a contract with the Kafra Staff Company.
scripts.translation: 会长，你还没有和卡普拉服务公司签订合约。

scripts.text: In order to hire a Kafra, you must first learn the Guild skill ^5533FFContract With Kafra^000000.
scripts.translation: 要雇用卡普拉员工，必须先学会公会技能^5533FF卡普拉合约^000000。

scripts.text: Would you like to employ the services of a Kafra? You will need ^5533FF10,000 Zeny^000000 to do so...
scripts.translation: 要雇用卡普拉员工吗？需要支付^5533FF10,000 Zeny^000000...

scripts.text: Employ Kafra.
scripts.translation: 雇用卡普拉员工。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Master, you do not have enough money to employ a Kafra. Employment has been cancelled.
scripts.translation: 会长，你的钱不够雇用卡普拉员工。雇用已取消。

scripts.text: You have created a contract with the Kafra Staff Company.
scripts.translation: 你已和卡普拉服务公司签订合约。

scripts.text: [ Kafra Staff ]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉员工]

scripts.text: How do you do? I'm here to provide you with helpful service! I'll do the best I can to serve you.
scripts.translation: 您好！我来为您提供贴心服务！我会竭尽全力为您服务。

scripts.text: I think the Kafra Staff will benefit our guild members.
scripts.translation: 我觉得卡普拉员工能为公会成员提供很多帮助。

scripts.text: As you wish Master.  But I suggest we get a Kafra as soon as possible!
scripts.translation: 如你所愿，会长。不过我建议尽快雇用一名卡普拉员工！

scripts.text: Would you like to dismiss the current Kafra?
scripts.translation: 要解雇目前的卡普拉员工吗？

scripts.text: Dismissal
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: [ Kafra Staff ]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉员工]

scripts.text: Have I done anything wrong? If I did, will you please forgive me?
scripts.translation: 我做错什么了吗？如果有，请原谅我，好吗？

scripts.text: Dismiss
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: [ Kafra Staff ]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉员工]

scripts.text: It's unfortunate that I won't be able to serve your guild anymore....
scripts.translation: 真遗憾，我以后不能再为公会服务了...

scripts.text: The Kafra has been dismissed.  But... we should really get a Kafra as soon as possible!
scripts.translation: 卡普拉员工已解雇。不过...我们确实应该尽快再雇一名卡普拉员工！

scripts.text: [ Kafra Staff ]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉员工]

scripts.text: Thank you master, I'll do my best! ^^.
scripts.translation: 谢谢会长，我会尽全力！^^.

scripts.text: Master, I think you should keep the current Kafra Staff because she is already trying her best to serve us
scripts.translation: 会长，我觉得应该留下这位卡普拉员工，因为她已经在尽力为大家服务了。

scripts.text: Would you to go to our Treasure Room? Only you, the Guild Master, are allowed to enter this room.
scripts.translation: 要去我们的宝物库吗？只有你，公会会长，才能进入这里。

scripts.text: Enter Treasure room.
scripts.translation: 进入宝物库。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Please follow me through the secret passage way.
scripts.translation: 请跟我穿过秘密通道。

scripts.text: You must pull down on the secret switch in order to get out.
scripts.translation: 你必须拉下秘密开关才能出去。

scripts.text: The goods are produced everyday.
scripts.translation: 每天都会生产这些物资。

scripts.text: You should get them whenever you can because they might dissapear if you take them at the wrong time.
scripts.translation: 有机会就尽快领取，因为如果时间不对，它们可能会消失。

scripts.text: As you wish, master.
scripts.translation: 如你所愿，会长。
